# Depth fog

Screen-space fog from the depth buffer: linear or exponential with distance, optionally thinning above a height for ground mist. Works with any material because it runs after the scene renders.

<EffectDemo effect="depth-fog" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { depthFog } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/depth-fog';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(depthFog({ preset: 'haze' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.color = '#6f7f9f'`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter       | Type                                                       | Default          | Range     | Description                                                                      |
| --------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------- | --------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `color`         | hex color (theme: [`surface`](/guide/holocss#theme-roles)) | `'#6f7f9f'`      |           | Fog color.                                                                       |
| `mode`          | 'linear' \| 'exponential' \| 'exponential2'                | `'exponential2'` |           | How density grows with distance: evenly between start and end, or exponentially. |
| `start`         | number                                                     | `2`              | 0 – 100   | Distance where fog begins, in scene units.                                       |
| `end`           | number                                                     | `30`             | 0.1 – 500 | Linear: distance where fog is thickest.                                          |
| `density`       | number                                                     | `0.06`           | 0 – 1     | Exponential: fog per scene unit.                                                 |
| `heightFalloff` | number                                                     | `0`              | 0 – 5     | How quickly fog thins above the base height; 0 fills the whole view.             |
| `height`        | number                                                     | `0`              | -50 – 50  | Base height of the fog in world units.                                           |
| `maxOpacity`    | number                                                     | `1`              | 0 – 1     | Thickest the fog gets.                                                           |
| `background`    | boolean                                                    | `true`           |           | Fog the background too (it counts as the far plane).                             |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset       | Settings                                                                                    |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `haze`       | `density: 0.035`, `color: '#8c9ab5'`, `maxOpacity: 0.8`                                     |
| `groundMist` | `density: 0.25`, `heightFalloff: 2.5`, `height: 0`, `color: '#9aa7c0'`, `background: false` |
| `night`      | `color: '#0b0f1c'`, `density: 0.09`                                                         |
| `linear`     | `mode: 'linear'`, `start: 4`, `end: 24`                                                     |

Apply one with `depthFog({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Atmosphere & lighting · tracked as story X10.1 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** reads only its own pixel, so it merges into the pass before it.
- **Geometry buffers:** reads depth, which the composer renders only while an effect needs them.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Size:** 5.3 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/depth-fog`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Credits

Original implementation (MIT). References: Linear, exponential and exponential-squared distance fog with exponential height falloff, as in OpenGL fixed-function fog.
